blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan Fifth Division on Monday ordered the 90-day preventive suspension of Sen. Jinggoy Estrada over a plunder case involving alleged irregularities in P573 million worth of infrastructure projects under the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) for 2025. The five-page resolution penned by Associate Justice Zaldy Trespeses, chair of the Fifth Division, was promulgated on Oct. 12. Special prosecutors alleged that the case stemmed from an “intricate mechanism involving illegal budgetary insertions and project allocations” in the DPWH’s 2025 infrastructure budget.
